name: Kuchiki Chizuru
source:
Young Chizuru. Came to the Kuroya Clinic her grandfather [url=/c11307]Kuroya Sou[/url] manages to recuperate due to her weak constitution. Her brother [url=/c11308]Fumiya[/url] accompanied her as her chaperone.

She spends her time walking around the settlement with Fumiya and taking pictures, which is her hobby. 

"Later... can I take a picture of you, Nii-san?"

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=139]MangaGamer[/url]]
